definitions.explanation: A group of things tied or wrapped together.

examples.japanese: {花|はな}の{束|たば}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a bunch of flowers.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}を{束|たば}にして{整理|せいり}する。
examples.english: To organize the documents into bundles.

examples.japanese: {札束|さつたば}を{数|かぞ}える。
examples.english: To count a stack of bills.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {花束|はなたば} (bouquet, bunch of flowers)
- {札束|さつたば} (wad of bills, stack of money)
- {束|たば}にする (to bundle together)

COUNTER USE:
- {一束|ひとたば} (one bundle)
- {二束|ふたたば} (two bundles)

COLLOCATIONS:
- {束|たば}を{解|ほど}く (to untie a bundle)
- {束|たば}にして{縛|しば}る (to tie into a bundle)
